headline: Approved May 6, 2026 meeting minutes as amended, 5-0.
summary: The committee reviewed updates on open space parcels and trails across several wards, including the Trask Lane Conservation Restriction, Norwood Pond Bridge construction, Sally Milligan trail extension, and a possible kiosk for the Hannah School/Solar Farm Trails. Aidan Judge's father presented an Eagle Scout project proposal, and the committee agreed Aidan Judge would return later to continue discussing it. The committee approved the May 6, 2026 meeting minutes as amended, 5-0.
decisions: Approved the May 6, 2026 meeting minutes, as amended, 5-0.
